# Plot the 'Dagger' column over time

plt.plot(time_series_df['CE'], time_series_df['Dagger'], label='Dagger Z Values')
plt.xlabel('Common Era (CE)')
plt.ylabel('Z Values')
plt.title('Z Values for Daggers Over Time')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()

# Calculate the rolling mean of the 'Dagger' column with a window size of 50 years
time_series_df['Dagger_rolling_mean'] = time_series_df['Dagger'].rolling(window=50).mean()

# Plot the original 'Dagger' Z values and the rolling mean
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
plt.plot(time_series_df['CE'], time_series_df['Dagger'], label='Dagger Z Values')
plt.plot(time_series_df['CE'], time_series_df['Dagger_rolling_mean'], label='Rolling Mean (50 years)', color='red')
plt.xlabel('Common Era (CE)')
plt.ylabel('Z Values')
plt.title('Z Values for Daggers and Rolling Mean Over Time')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()

# Identify the time period around the 1st century CE
